question.text: Ganga Credit Opportunities Fund II (Cat II AIF) has a Total Committed Capital of INR 300 crore. The PPM fixes Management Fees at 2.00% p.a. (excluding GST of 18%) charged on Committed Capital during the commitment period. For Year 1, what is the TOTAL CASH OUTFLOW of the fund towards Management Fees, including GST?

explanation.text: The Logic: Base fee = 2.00% x INR 300 crore = INR 6.00 crore. GST @ 18% on INR 6.00 crore = INR 1.08 crore. Total outflow = INR 6.00 + INR 1.08 = INR 7.08 crore. Chapter 6 (Example 6.1/6.2) follows this exact pattern: fee x committed capital, then gross-up with GST at 18%. The Trap: A stops before adding GST and reports only the pre-GST fee; B is an arithmetic slip; C applies 18% as a deduction instead of an addition (INR 6.00 x 0.90 = INR 5.40 cr is a common trap). Option D is the correct INR 7.08 crore answer. Note: Corrected the trap label that previously described option D as a miscomputation; D is the keyed correct answer. Removed the Cross-Exam Context paragraph and the broader GST-input-credit pro-tip; the workbook's GST-recoverability framing is cautious and the bps-impact illustration goes beyond pp.90, 113 and 129-131.
